Zhou Anzhi did not go back to her Meiyuan but went to her and Jian Yurong's yard. Grandma Xi had known each other for many years before they were married. It could be said that she knew very well how Grandma Jian Xi had come to be here over the years. However, Yang Guang's ignorance did not mean that Tu Wanxu was incompetent.
